Alex Chen: Morning deploy owners — quick check. We're planning to push the release train 09:30 UTC slot to prod. Can owners confirm they're available and prepared for smoke + rollback window? @Maya @Sam
Maya Patel: I'm on for 09:30. I'll be primary for backend changes, smoke will include /health, DB migrations dry-run, and canary at 10%. I'll be on pager 09:15-10:00.
Sam Ortiz: Frontend is green. I'll handle the canary traffic shift. Noted for smoke checklist. I can shift to 09:45 if we need stagger.
Jordan Lee: Infra will be standing by. I've pre-warmed VMs and reserved extra capacity in us-west. Rollback tag is release/2026-03-15-v3 (will keep ready).
Lina Gomez: Quick heads-up — I still need one small CR merged (PR #5882). ETA 09:00 PT. If it lands I'll re-run the smoke locally.
Alex Chen: @Lina please ping here when merged. If not merged by 09:05 we skip and proceed with feature-flag off.
deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-03-15 09:30 UTC — owners: Maya, Sam. Canary: 10% for 10 mins. Auto-rollback: disabled (manual).
Maya Patel: Smoke checklist: 1) /health 2) basic user flow 3) embedding latencies 4) error-rate < 0.5% 5) metrics dashboard refresh. I'll check 1-3 at 09:32.
Sam Ortiz: I'll open a tiny dashboard watch: frontend errors, 5XX spike, JS bundle mismatch. Ping @all if anything >2x baseline.
Jordan Lee: Rollback plan: snapshot infra at 09:25, DB migration has no blocking changes (read-only). If we hit >1% errors for 5 mins or spike in tail latency, we rollback to tag above.
Lina Gomez: CR merged at 08:58 PT — linking PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5882 :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Awesome. Final confirm: Maya executes deploy, Sam handles canary traffic, Jordan executes infra ops if rollback, Lina monitors CI/PR regressions. Anyone need runway or extra eyes?
Maya Patel: All good from me. I'll post smoke results here when done.
Sam Ortiz: I'll be on-call for canary shift. If smoke fails, start rollback checklist and @Jordan to restore infra.
Jordan Lee: Copy. I'll keep the rollback playbook open: /docs/runbooks/rollback.md
Alex Chen: Thanks team — I'll update the release train roster with this owner set. See you at 09:30 UTC. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Note: please add a brief post-deploy note to the release-train thread after smoke is green.
